# Rate limits

Counted in one-minute windows unless the limit says otherwise. Over a limit, the call is refused with `429` `rate_limited` and a `Retry-After` header in seconds; nothing the call sent is saved. Retry after the wait. `syncDocuments()` in `@opem/node` retries `429` and `503` for you, up to three times.

| Limit | Calls | What it counts |
|---|---|---|
| `widgetPerProject` | 600 | Widget calls for one project, all visitors together. |
| `widgetPerIp` | 120 | Widget calls for one project from one client address (an IPv6 /64), whoever they claim to be (#340). |
| `helpSearchPerIp` | 30 | Public help centre searches from one client address, a minute (#338). |
| `helpSearchPerProject` | 300 | Public help centre searches for one project, every address together, a minute (#338). |
| `widgetPerEndUser` | 60 | Widget calls for one end user, once the call has an identity. |
| `managementPerKey` | 120 | Management API calls with a project's secret key. |
| `enquiriesPerIpPerHour` | 5 | Enquiries from one IP address in one hour (an hourly window, unlike the others). |
| `authPerIpPerWindow` | 30 | Sign-in, sign-up, reset and code calls from one client address in ten minutes (#340). |
| `authPerEmailPerWindow` | 10 | The same calls naming one email in ten minutes, from one network: an IPv4 /24 or IPv6 /48 (#340). |
| `authPerEmailAllNetworksPerWindow` | 100 | The same calls naming one email in ten minutes, from every network together (#340). |
| `agentPerGrantPerWindow` | 300 | MCP tool calls and listings for one agent grant in ten minutes (#476). |
